name: Chijoku Yuugi
source:
Main character barely escapes rape charges by hiding in the lodge that stays abandoned at this season. One day owners of the lodge come by. They are two girls. They want to call police, but get captured by protagonist before they succeed at that. He can fulfill all his desires now. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公为了躲避强奸罪名，勉强逃进这座季节性废弃的旅馆。一天，旅馆的主人——两名女孩——前来查看。她们正要报警，却被主人公抢先抓住。如今，他终于可以满足自己的全部欲望。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
